VegetationLibrary__StandardPalettes__Met.Meta__Description: Standard palettes: mixes of plants every project can start from. Chosen in a tool's palette list, one is copied into the project as its own palette (Vegetation__Palette__StandardId says which), so a later change here alters no project. Kept by hand.
VegetationLibrary__StandardPalettes__Met.Meta__LayoutNote: Palette__PlantScale and Palette__SpacingMm are the path layout the mix was proven at. Choosing the palette in the Line Tool sets both on the path; the Brush Tool takes the scale, its density and spacing following.

VegetationLibrary__StandardPalettes__Pal.Palette__Description: A low, full run of small shrubs for a raised planter: mostly rounded mounds, some upright, the odd yew cone. From the arched planter at 64610 Corrett (Path 2), 12-Nov-2026.
The Small Planting Bed Shrubs mix grown on: the same plants and shares at 0.70, spaced in step (348 x 0.70 / 0.45), for a deeper bed or a planter seen from further off.
